paragraphs.en: Human values, community and connection
paragraphs.zh: 人文价值、社群与人与人的联结

paragraphs.en: All of this, as much as anything, is about putting human values, communities and fellow citizens at the centre of what we do.
paragraphs.zh: 所有这一切，归根结底，都是将人文价值、社群与普通民众置于我们工作的核心。

paragraphs.en: This sounds obvious, but it isn't.
paragraphs.zh: 这话听来浅显，实则不然。

paragraphs.en: So much of the world around us increasingly seems to be organised according to different principles.
paragraphs.zh: 我们周遭世界的诸多事物，如今愈发依照另一套截然不同的准则运转。

paragraphs.en: In a recent Guardian long read, Rebecca Solnit wrote about how Silicon Valley CEOs preach that we must prioritise "convenience, efficiency, productivity, profitability" above all else.
paragraphs.zh: 《卫报》一篇近期长篇特稿中，丽贝卡·索尔尼特写道，硅谷各大企业首席执行官鼓吹，我们必须把“便捷、效率、产能、盈利”置于一切之上。

paragraphs.en: "They have told us that to go out into the world, to interact with others, is perilous, unpleasant, inefficient, a waste of time."
paragraphs.zh: “他们告诉我们，走出家门、与人交往充满风险、令人不快、毫无效率，纯粹是浪费时间。”

paragraphs.en: These are anti-human values.
paragraphs.zh: 这些都是反人性的价值观。

paragraphs.en: As Solnit writes, "We have withdrawn, while being constantly told this is good, and it has turned out to be bad in a thousand small ways, weakening public life and local institutions, isolating us."
paragraphs.zh: 索尔尼特写道：“我们不断退守独处，旁人却总说这是好事，可无数细微的事实证明其弊端，公共生活与地方机构日渐衰败，人与人彼此隔绝。”

paragraphs.en: The rise of AI appears to be exacerbating these anti-human trends.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能的兴起，似乎进一步加剧了这些反人性的趋势。

paragraphs.en: Name a job and someone somewhere is claiming that a machine will soon do it better than any human can, or already does.
paragraphs.zh: 随便说出一份职业，总有人宣称机器很快会比人类做得更好，甚至当下已然超越人类。

paragraphs.en: Not just jobs, but some of our most cherished activities: writing, music, film, art; even care, relationships and love.
paragraphs.zh: 不光是各类工作，我们最为珍视的诸多活动也未能幸免：写作、音乐、电影、美术；甚至照料他人、人际交往与爱意本身。

paragraphs.en: The blurring of the boundaries between human and machine, the real and the fake, have had some truly horrifying consequences in recent years, from chatbot-induced psychosis to AI-powered weapons systems.
paragraphs.zh: 人与机器、真实与虚假的边界不断模糊，近些年已经催生诸多可怖后果，从聊天机器人诱发精神失常，到人工智能驱动的武器系统。

paragraphs.en: Sometimes we treat people online as if they are already computer-generated.
paragraphs.zh: 有时我们在网上对待他人，仿佛对方本就是计算机生成的虚拟形象。

paragraphs.en: To be clear, AI can be an incredible tool. I find it useful; it helped me find some sources for this article.
paragraphs.zh: 需要说明的是，人工智能本可以是绝佳工具。我自身也会使用，它帮我为这篇文章查找了部分资料。

paragraphs.en: And at the Guardian, we are committed to using every tool at our disposal to produce the best journalism we can.
paragraphs.zh: 而《卫报》始终愿意运用一切可用工具，产出最优质的新闻报道。

paragraphs.en: This requires great care, but that is the challenge we have set ourselves: to think deeply about what makes our journalism human and essential, and about how AI can help us build on that foundation rather than undermine it.
paragraphs.zh: 这需要万分谨慎，而这正是我们给自己定下的挑战：深度思考新闻的人文内核与不可替代性，思考人工智能如何在此基础上赋能，而非摧毁这份根基。

paragraphs.en: In February, we published an article that would have been impossible without the assistance of AI: an analysis of 100 years of immigration rhetoric in the UK parliament, realised through a collaboration between our data journalists, data scientists and researchers from University College London.
paragraphs.zh: 今年二月，我们刊发了一篇若无人工智能协助便无法完成的报道：文章分析英国议会百年来有关移民的言论变迁，由本报数据记者、数据科学家与伦敦大学学院研究员联合完成。

paragraphs.en: The piece showed that over the past five years, MPs' attitudes have swung harder to the right than at almost any other time in the last century.
paragraphs.zh: 报道显示，过去五年，议员的立场向右翼倾斜的幅度，在上个世纪几乎无出其右。

paragraphs.en: But at the same time, we also want to emphasise the things that we can do that AI cannot.
paragraphs.zh: 但与此同时，我们也想强调人类独有的、人工智能无法复刻的能力。

paragraphs.en: On-the-ground reporting, talking to people in deep and intimate ways.
paragraphs.zh: 奔赴一线实地采访，与民众进行深入、真诚的交流。

paragraphs.en: Holding the powerful to account. Breaking news. Questioning conventional wisdom.
paragraphs.zh: 监督掌权者、令其承担责任。突发新闻报道。质疑固有成见。

paragraphs.en: Curating and editing thoughtfully, so that audiences encounter serendipity, rather than being fed more of the same by algorithms, or so-called "liquid content", magically generated in response to your perceived needs.
paragraphs.zh: 用心筛选、编辑内容，让读者邂逅意料之外的新知，而非算法一味推送同质化内容，或是根据你的偏好自动生成的所谓“流动内容”。

paragraphs.en: In a world in which the early promise of social media has dissolved into a toxic wasteland, we are committed to building communities and hosting conversations among Guardian readers and with our journalists – on our own site but also well beyond it, on other platforms and in person.
paragraphs.zh: 社交媒体早年的美好愿景早已沦为充斥恶意的荒芜之地，在此背景下，我们致力于搭建社群，组织《卫报》读者之间、读者与记者之间的交流——交流阵地不仅限于自家官网，也拓展至其他线上平台，以及线下线下面对面活动。

paragraphs.en: We want our audience to feel connected to the writers and voices and faces that make the Guardian.
paragraphs.zh: 我们希望读者能与创作《卫报》内容的撰稿人、发声者、出镜记者建立联结。

paragraphs.en: A relationship with a real human being. A community of real human beings. And this is not a one-way relationship.
paragraphs.zh: 一段真实人与人之间的羁绊。一个由真实普通人构成的社群。且这份联结绝非单向输出。

paragraphs.en: Our audience helps shape what we do, and even provides us with valuable tips.
paragraphs.zh: 读者会参与塑造我们的报道方向，还会向我们提供极具价值的爆料线索。

paragraphs.en: One of our major investigations this year, about Nigel Farage's use of the video platform Cameo, began with a tip from a reader.
paragraphs.zh: 本报今年一篇重磅调查，聚焦奈杰尔·法拉奇利用短视频平台卡米奥牟利，线索最初就来自一名读者的爆料。

paragraphs.en: At its best, the Guardian brings people together.
paragraphs.zh: 《卫报》最好的价值，便是凝聚人心。

paragraphs.en: It's something other institutions do in times like these, too: the library, the school, the sports team.
paragraphs.zh: 当下这个时代，图书馆、学校、运动队等机构也在承担相同作用。

paragraphs.en: They provide a point of stability.
paragraphs.zh: 它们为人们提供一处安稳的落脚点。

paragraphs.en: In a world that often feels like it's gone mad, good journalism can also provide that feeling of recognition, or relief, when you discover you are not the only one to see the world as you do.
paragraphs.zh: 在这个时常令人觉得混乱失序的世界里，优质新闻能带来共鸣与宽慰，让你发觉并非只有自己拥有这般看待世界的视角。

paragraphs.en: Reading the Guardian, you're never alone.
paragraphs.zh: 阅读《卫报》，你永远不会孤身一人。

paragraphs.en: You are part of a global community of like-minded people.
paragraphs.zh: 你身处一个理念相通的全球社群之中。

paragraphs.en: That doesn't mean a community of people who agree on everything.
paragraphs.zh: 但这不代表社群内所有人事事观点统一。

paragraphs.en: The Guardian is the kind of institution that encourages debate.
paragraphs.zh: 《卫报》是鼓励思辨辩论的机构。

paragraphs.en: In our London office, every morning, we have an open meeting, in person, that every journalist can attend, from the most junior to the most senior.
paragraphs.zh: 伦敦总部每天早晨都会举办线下公开会议，所有记者无论资历深浅，均可到场参与。

paragraphs.en: We discuss the issues of the day, and how we should be covering them.
paragraphs.zh: 我们探讨当日热点议题，商议报道思路。

paragraphs.en: A friend suggested that this might be one of the last such daily face-to-face political discussions happening anywhere.
paragraphs.zh: 一位友人说，这类每日面对面的时政讨论会，如今已是为数不多。

paragraphs.en: Naturally, we sometimes have strong disagreements.
paragraphs.zh: 自然，我们时常产生激烈分歧。

paragraphs.en: But this is part of being human – and how we manage disagreement is a measure of our humanity.
paragraphs.zh: 但分歧本就是人性的一部分，而我们处理分歧的方式，恰恰衡量着我们的人文底色。
